The '''Imperial base camp''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] base in the [[Barren Frost]] region on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].

At the [[Battle of Ilum]] the personnel stationed there included [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tetsu (Sith)|Tetsu]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Dermian]] and the [[Geranite/Legends|Geranite]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Che'nash]]. The [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[G-4T]] was also deploy in it.
